adapter: Apple M3 Pro, Metal, integrated GPU

text.command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo bench -p rxui --bench text --features rendering,accessibility --locked
text.accessibility_command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo bench -p rxui --bench text --features rendering,accessibility --locked -- --accessibility
text.single_buffer_note: Same benchmark with the whole text area in one Astrelis buffer, before paragraph chunks; one run.
text.whole_runs_note: With 8-paragraph chunks but before incremental AccessKit text runs; one run.

frame.command: target/release/deps/frame-<hash> --bench, built with CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo bench -p rxui --bench frame --features rendering,accessibility --locked --no-run
frame.baseline: git archive of db84b44 built into a separate target directory; base and current binaries alternated run by run

notes: Interactive machine shared with other builds; values are batch averages, not individual-frame latency.
CPU only: no surface acquisition, submission, presentation or native event loop.
